about: A monorepo for product projects, each promoted from prototype to a real, runnable, deployable project, offline-first and server-optional.

features.title: Orbis
features.body: Communication, identity, protection and hiring in one app, on a zero-dependency Python server.

features.title: Peers
features.body: Verified reviews across category modes, every category sharing one interface.

features.title: House of Articles
features.body: Athlete-moment sneaker news with a live market feed.

features.title: Hazel
features.body: A desktop studio for creators: auto-cut, repurpose, publish, measure.

features.title: Lingua
features.body: Live-translated Teams captions in an always-on-top overlay.

features.title: Pips
features.body: An always-on-top Pomodoro timer and daily score widget.
